hero.filename: Leinster House in Dublin, seat of the Oireachtas.jpg
hero.caption: A head-on, symmetrical view of the main façade of Leinster House in Dublin, Ireland. The large, grey-stone neoclassical building, home to the Oireachtas (Irish parliament), is seen from its forecourt. Several people are visible walking near the main entrance at the centre. The Irish tricolour flag is flying from a flagpole on the roof. The foreground includes benches, potted plants, and paving stones.

images.filename: Inside the Dáil - The Irish Parliament Chamber.jpg
images.caption:
The photograph offers a comprehensive view of the Dáil Éireann, the main parliamentary chamber of Ireland. The room's architecture is dominated by warm, dark wood, covering walls, benches, and the central speaker's podium. A striking royal blue carpet with an intricate light blue and gold border covers the floor, providing a strong contrast to the wooden elements.
The seating is arranged in a horseshoe configuration, with multiple tiers of individual brown leather chairs facing inwards towards a central speaking area. Two main blocks of seating curve around the left and right sides of the chamber, with additional seating visible in the foreground.

At the far end of the room, an elevated platform features a large, ornate wooden Speaker's chair. To its left, the Irish national flag (green, white, and orange vertical stripes) is prominently displayed on a stand. Above the Speaker's chair, a circular clock is embedded in the wood paneling, flanked by two large, dark rectangular screens mounted high on the wall. The ceiling features a light-colored, pleated curtain, and lighting fixtures are visible throughout the space. The overall impression is one of solemnity and tradition, befitting a national legislative body.
